description: pnpm rangeStrategy (update-lockfile) + minimumReleaseAge now come from the shared renovate-config-pnpm preset (DAG-144). Only repo-specific rules remain below.

packageRules.description: Pinned to v3 until src/config/schema.ts is migrated to the v4 API

Pinned to v4: v5 is ESM-only and drops the default export, which breaks a transitive default-import in the docs-site astro/starlight prerender path (js-yaml v5 reverted in PR after #250). Lift once the docs toolchain supports v5.

Transitive-vuln override pins live in pnpm-workspace.yaml and are managed by hand, not Renovate. Disable them so Renovate stops attempting the override-entry lookups that raise the 'failed to look up npm package tmp: no-result' dependency-lookup warning.
